test_title: PYST 16: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the given sentence.**

They saw fit to (banish) him from the party and exclude him from the election campaign.
solution: The correct answer is: **E****x**ile [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Exile means the state or a period of forced absence from one's country or home. (राज्य या किसी के देश या घर से जबरन अनुपस्थिति की अवधि) • Example -* He knew now that he would die in exile.* • The bracketed word Banish means to send someone away from a country or place as an official punishment. (आधिकारिक दंड के रूप में किसी को किसी देश या स्थान से दूर भेजना) • Example -* A number of people were banished to Siberia for political crimes.* • It is clear that 'Exile' and 'Banish' are similar in meaning. Therefore the correct answer is option 4.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Persevere **means to try to do or continue doing something in a determined way, despite difficulties. (कठिनाइयों के बावजूद, एक दृढ़ तरीके से कुछ करने या जारी रखने का प्रयास करना) • **Revolt **means taking violent action against an established government or ruler; rebel. (एक स्थापित सरकार या शासक के खिलाफ हिंसक कार्रवाई करना; बागी) • **Distress **means extreme anxiety, sorrow, or pain. (अत्यधिक चिंता, दुःख या दर्द) 3c:T7c5, The erroneous part of the sentence is: **of biggest factors**
